

<style>
.all-container {
    line-height: 0px;
}

.container {
  display: inline;
  padding: 0px;
  margin: 0px;
}

.container > .heart {
  display: inline-block;
  height: 5vw; /* adjust to control the size */
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  clip-path: shape(from 50% 91%,line to 90% 50%,arc to 50% 9%  of 1%,arc to 10% 50% of 1%);
  background: #cc333f;
  padding: 0px;
  margin: -2px;

  transition-duration: 1s;
  transition-delay: 3s;
}

.heart:hover, .heart:active,
.container:hover > .heart, .container:active > .heart {
  clip-path: shape(from 0% 0%,line to 0% 100%,arc to 100% 100% of 1%, arc to 100% 0% of 1%);
  transform: rotate(360deg);
  transition: .1s;
}

</style>
